## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Behavior changes have a test in `test/` and, if they touch the transport, an asserted example in `examples/`
- [ ] Observable changes have a line under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`, saying why
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
- [ ] Decisions that were considered and rejected are written down in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
